name: Honda ST1300
engine: 1261 cc liquid-cooled V4, fuel injected, shaft drive
intro: Honda's V4 sport tourer. Durable. Check the rear brake hose recall on 2008-2010 bikes.

A-002.title: Check for open recalls
A-002.instructions: Run your VIN at nhtsa.gov/recalls. 2008-2010 ST1300s were in recall 11V356 because the rear brake reservoir hose can be damaged when the suspension bottoms out.
A-002.reason: A damaged hose can leak brake fluid and lose the rear brake. The repair is free.

recalls.what: Rear brake reservoir hose can be damaged and leak fluid.
